title.zh: 周长与面积 · 一圈和里面
title.en: Perimeter vs area · around and inside

description.zh: 周长是绕图形一圈的长度，面积是图形里面铺满要多少块方格；同一根 24 米的绳子能围出 11 到 36 平方米不等的长方形，越接近正方形面积越大，所以周长相同不代表面积相同。
description.en: Perimeter is the length around a shape and area is how many squares fill its inside; the same 24-metre rope can enclose rectangles of anywhere from 11 to 36 square metres, larger the closer to a square, so equal perimeters do not mean equal areas.

zh: 围成什么形状面积最大
en: which shape encloses the most area

label.en: Scaled up, one grows ×k and the other ×k²

reason.zh: 图形放大 k 倍，周长作为长度只变 k 倍，面积却变 k² 倍——又一个说明周长和面积是两种不同量的例子。
reason.en: Scale a shape by k and its perimeter, being a length, grows k times while its area grows k² times — one more sign that perimeter and area are different kinds of quantity.

question.zh: 周长一样的两块地，面积一定一样大吗？
question.en: Do two plots with the same perimeter always have the same area?

ask.zh: 24 米绳子围长方形，长从 1 米变到 6 米，面积怎样变？
ask.en: Fencing a rectangle with 24 m of rope, how does the area change as the length goes from 1 m to 6 m?

ask.zh: 面积数的是什么？为什么等于长 × 宽？
ask.en: What does area count, and why is it length × width?

reveal.zh: 不一定。周长量的是一圈的长度，面积数的是里面的方格；同样 24 米的周长，1 × 11 的长方形只有 11 平方米，6 × 6 的正方形有 36 平方米。
reveal.en: Not necessarily. Perimeter measures the length around, area counts the squares inside; with the same 24 m perimeter a 1 × 11 rectangle holds only 11 m², while a 6 × 6 square holds 36 m².
